caption: One message passes through three tools in turn, and each step answers exactly one question: the shared-key cipher hides it, the hash catches any change, the private-key signature proves who sent it. No single step does all of this, which is why the tools are used together.

spec.title: How the primitives compose
spec.aria: A message is encrypted with a shared key into ciphertext, the ciphertext is hashed into a digest, the digest is signed with a private key, and the receiver checks the signature with the public key and then decrypts.
